sources.title: ruri-v3-310m: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Ruri-v3-70m (70M params, 384 dims, 75.48 JMTEB) is a middle ground. Ruri-v3-130m (132M params, 512 dims, 76.55 JMTEB) is slightly smaller and slower but still very strong. Choose the 310M variant only if you need the highest accuracy and have sufficient GPU memory. Q: Can I fine-tune this model on my own Japanese text data? A: Yes.

sources.snippet: A collection of ONNX-converted versions of ruri-v3, a high-performance, lightweight Japanese-specific embedding model based on modernBERT-ja.
